description: Excellence in Education Illinois schools are failing far too many children. According to the Illinois State Board of Education, only 36.5% of Illinois students were proficient in English Language Arts in 2025—meaning nearly two out of every three students were not proficient. That is not a minor shortfall—it is a crisis. As a literacy teacher for 19 of my 30 years in the classroom, I know firsthand that teaching children to read requires a focus on proven fundamentals.
